registered: see the git commit that added this file (2026-10-05): after C1's single VAL pass (whose CST result motivates it) and before any C1c training
class: follow-up controlled experiment; TRAIN fitting, TRAIN-dev choices, ONE VAL pass; TEST sealed
motivation: C1 (reports/C1_trajectory_forecasting.md): the pooled transformer beats the TRAIN-best classical forecaster on Anti-UAV IR (-8 to -10 % ADE) and RGB (-7 to -9 %) but LOSES on CST (+44 to +48 % vs damped mean velocity). Hypothesis (stated before any C1c run): training pooled over gimbal (mean-reverting) and static (inertial) footage without telling the model which camera it is fitted to imposes re-centring dynamics on CST. A deployed system knows its camera mode (tracking gimbal vs static mount), so conditioning on it is legitimate.
data_and_samples: exactly C1's (tc_data trajectories, TRAIN non-dev / dev / VAL, L = 16, H = 24, oracle histories, every eligible anchor)

arms.domtok: C1's family (transformer, abs inputs, clean, C1's recipe) trained pooled with a 3-way camera-mode token in the global input (antiuav_IR / antiuav_RGB / cst); seeds 0, 1, 2
arms.perdom: the same family trained on ONE domain's TRAIN only (dev = that domain's dev groups), one model per domain; seeds 0, 1, 2

choice_on_dev: per domain, the arm with the lower seed-mean dev NLL on that domain's dev groups is the C1c model of that domain (decided before --stage val)

H1c_point.what: the domain's C1c model vs the domain's TRAIN-chosen classical reference (C1's), each seed

H2c_vs_pooled.what: the domain's C1c model vs C1's pooled model (seed i vs seed i)
H2c_vs_pooled.SUPPORTED: all 3 pairs: relative ADE change <= -5 % and CI upper < 0

H3c_uncertainty.what: the domain's C1c model vs the TRAIN-calibrated Kalman

comparisons_on_val.a_priori_expectation: H2c SUPPORTED on CST; no directional expectation on Anti-UAV (C1 already beats the classical reference there)

adoption_rule: per domain, the learned forecaster offered to C1b / C3 / CF = the C1c model if H1c is SUPPORTED and (H2c is SUPPORTED or C1's H1 was not SUPPORTED in that domain); else C1's pooled model if C1 adopted it there; else none (classical reference). Pre-run amendments to C1b and C3 record that they use this adoption.

component_gate.measured_failure: pooled learned forecaster +44-48 % ADE on CST (C1, VAL)
component_gate.why: conflicting dynamics across camera modes in one model without a mode input
component_gate.baseline: the domain's TRAIN-chosen classical reference and C1's pooled model
component_gate.novelty: camera-mode-aware forecasting for anti-UAV tracking (gimbal re-centring vs static-camera inertia), with calibrated uncertainty
component_gate.cost: same network (+3 input features for domtok); CPU training minutes
component_gate.isolating_ablation: domtok vs pooled (same data, one input added); perdom vs pooled (data restricted)
component_gate.falsifier: H1c NOT_SUPPORTED / LOSES on CST for the dev-chosen arm

run_order: tc_c1c.py --stage train (gated to start just after a GPU training has sized its loader workers)
